title: Probing the Accuracy of Adiabatic-Connection Exchange-Correlation Functionals with Highly Accurate, Strongly Correlated Electron Data
description: Reference data, analysis and plotting scripts, data-generating drivers, and SCE code for benchmarking adiabatic-connection models and strong-interaction-limit approximations on Hookium, the He isoelectronic series (H- to Ar16+), H2 dissociation, and neutral atoms and ions.
